# uuBright

> uuBright is an independent engineering studio. This file is a navigation aid for readers and AI tools; linked public pages are the authoritative sources.

## Company and products

- [uuBright](https://uubright.com/): Company overview, AI infrastructure, usage systems, technical education, and contact information.
- [MyMedia Photos](https://photos.uubright.com/): Local-first photo organizer for macOS, by uuBright. Public Apple Silicon beta build 80 is available; a free first public local-app release is planned.
- [MyMedia Photos privacy policy](https://photos.uubright.com/privacy/): Local processing, Google Drive permissions, credentials, retention, external services, and contact.
- [uuRoute](https://uuroute.ai/): Routing, observability, and governance for production AI.
- [Meterry](https://meterry.com/): Usage metering, pricing controls, and billing evidence.
- [SciMigo](https://scimigo.com/): Technical education and interactive learning.

> MyMedia Photos helps you understand and organize the photo archive you already own, without moving it into another library. Originals stay ordinary files in the user's folders; the app keeps its own index and settings databases on the Mac.

## MyMedia Photos facts (current download: version 0.1.0, build 80)

- Build 80 is publicly downloadable for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 14 or later. It is Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple, distributed outside the Mac App Store, and still a beta. No Intel build is offered.
- Indexes existing Mac folders and connected drives in place. Search by filename, capture date and recognized text; OCR and content labels run on the Mac.
- Exact-duplicate review is byte-for-byte: the user chooses the keeper; extras go to the macOS Trash after review, never permanently deleted.
- Organize folders previews dated year/month destinations and the space needed, then copies or moves only after approval; runs are journaled for undo.
- Backup copy copies a folder to another drive, checks every file with SHA-256 and writes a receipt. Local copies are not encrypted by MyMedia.
- iPhone in build 80: import with Apple Image Capture into a folder, then make a verified copy. MyMedia never deletes phone assets and never gives deletion advice.
- "Bring your photos together" gathers local folders into one archive with verified copies; it does not delete sources or certify a drive as safe to erase.
- Collections and albums are references to photos in place, not copies or backups.
- Experimental: encrypted cloud backup, Google Drive, WeChat, Apple Messages, Apple Photos browsing, visual search and face recognition.

## Coming in the next beta build (not in build 80; not downloadable yet)

- Guided iPhone flow (Import, Organize, Back up) with direct copy-only USB import of photos, videos and Live Photo companions; an organize step with undo; a coverage check that compares names and sizes only (a heuristic, not proof of identical files, never deletion advice).
- Similar-shot review with a Compare view: groups repeated takes and suggests a keeper; the user decides and nothing is removed automatically.
- Check or restore a Backup copy against its receipt.
- Space view ("Free up space"), drive setup wizard, drive card and drive survey, suggested albums from trips and events, videos browsable in Photos, dark mode.

## Privacy and network

- Local analysis does not upload photos. Do not describe the app as wholly offline: a daily update check (no app-generated identifier) requests appcast.json from api.scimigo.com, the owner's server, with a static uubright.com fallback; it can be switched off in About.
- Opt-in network features: place-name lookup (coordinates only, Apple geocoder); digital human generation (one portrait and a script to D-ID with the user's own key); S3 folder copies with the user's AWS CLI (not a backup: no MyMedia metadata, client-side encryption or restore); encrypted cloud backup; Google Drive.
- Encrypted cloud backup stores data in MyMedia's storage via backup.uubright.com, not in Google Drive; Google is used only to sign in. File contents, filenames and metadata are encrypted on the Mac; the service sees account identity, opaque keys, ciphertext sizes, counts and timing. The recovery phrase never reaches the service.
- Google Drive uses the account-wide drive.readonly permission; folder choice does not narrow it. Thumbnails come from Google's thumbnail hosts and are cached locally; originals download only when the user approves. Drive files are never moved, deleted or uploaded. Google Drive is distinct from Google Photos.
- Apple Messages browsing needs Full Disk Access but does not read the conversation database. WeChat browsing reads local photo files read-only and does not read messages.
- External AI agents (local MCP, bearer token) can read library information and propose cleanups or collections; only the user applies them.
- Support and privacy contact: support@uubright.com. Company contact: sales@uubright.com.
